regions.full_page: Between the two outlooks in Seattle and Los Angeles, I am in- clined to favor that in the former. This especially if the judge's daughters (are) old enough to take care of themselves and their father's house. In such cases there is nearly always the danger of jealousy. I hardly need tell you of examples in this phase of social wanderings: for as Moore rightly muses: "Poor wanderers of a stormy day, from wave to wave we're driven; And fancy's flash and reason's ray serve but to light the troubled ways; There's nothing calm but Heaven." As for the financial or business affairs referred to, I just do not like to dabble into them. Disregard for the claims of justice - under whatever pretext - has always been a manifestation of - to say the very least, of shallow thinking. Rather I would say its a betrayal of a want of' real thinking. In fact it seems to me that the all-outstanding character(istic) of atheism is nothing other than just disregard for justice and truth. Atheism, to every normally thinking mind a most blasphemous suggestion of the devil; the "omega" - climax - of intellectual and moral depravity at once; the hopeless con- clusion and the desperate refuge of shallow thinking, of degener- ate minds and of really damned fools, - their primary leader none other than Lucifer himself the outstanding prince of diabolical deceivers and - by God's permission - dictator in-chief in the kingdom of Hell.
